messageTypes.name: ApiResourceMetadata
messageTypes.description:
ApiResourceMetadata contains standard metadata for all API resources.
 Every resource belongs to an organization and has a visibility setting.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: Human-readable name of the resource.

fields.name: Slug
fields.description:
URL-friendly identifier, unique within the organization.
 Combined with org, forms the canonical reference: "org/slug".

fields.name: Id
fields.description: System-generated unique identifier.

fields.name: Org
fields.description:
Organization that owns this resource.
 In Local Mode: Set by the project manifest (seedpack bootstraps "stigmer" org).
 In Cloud Mode: Required and enforced by the Authorization Service.
 All resources belong to exactly one organization.

fields.name: Visibility
fields.description:
Visibility controls who can access this resource.
 - PRIVATE: Only members of the owning organization can access.
 - PUBLIC: Anyone can access (read). Write access still requires org membership.
 Default: PRIVATE for new resources.

fields.name: Labels
fields.description: Key-value labels for organization and filtering.

fields.name: Annotations
fields.description: Key-value annotations for additional metadata.

fields.name: Tags
fields.description: Tags for categorization.

fields.name: Version
fields.description: Version information for the resource.

fields.name: Id
fields.description: Unique identifier for this version.

fields.name: Message
fields.description: Message describing what changed in this version.

fields.name: PreviousVersionId
fields.description: Reference to the previous version ID.

messageTypes.name: ApiResourceAudit
messageTypes.description: ApiResourceAudit contains both spec-level and status-level audit details.

fields.name: SpecAudit
fields.description: Audit info for the resource's specification (desired state).

fields.name: StatusAudit
fields.description: Audit info for the resource's status (actual state).

fields.name: CreatedBy
fields.description: Actor who created this resource.

fields.name: CreatedAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the resource was created.

fields.name: UpdatedBy
fields.description: Actor who last updated this resource.

fields.name: UpdatedAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the resource was last updated.

fields.name: Event
fields.description: Type of the last event (e.g., "created", "updated").

messageTypes.name: ApiResourceAuditActor
messageTypes.description: ApiResourceAuditActor represents the entity that performed an action.

fields.name: Id
fields.description: Unique identifier of the actor.

fields.name: Avatar
fields.description: URL to the actor's avatar image.

values.name: api_resource_version
values.description: Agentic - System-level audit trails and versioning

values.name: project
values.description: Tenancy - Project management (aggregate root for resource lifecycle)

enumTypes.name: ApiResourceVisibility
enumTypes.description:
Visibility controls who can access an API resource.
 This is orthogonal to ownership - visibility is about access control,
 while ownership (org) determines who manages the resource.

 Key distinction:
 - Ownership: Which organization controls/manages the resource
 - Visibility: Who can access/use the resource

 All resources belong to an organization. Visibility determines whether
 users outside that organization can access the resource.

values.name: visibility_private
values.description:
Only members of the owning organization can access.
 This is the default for most resources.
 Named visibility_private to avoid Java reserved keyword conflict.

values.name: visibility_public
values.description:
Anyone can access (read) this resource.
 Used for marketplace-published resources (e.g., "stigmer/web-search").
 Write access still requires org membership.
 Named visibility_public to avoid Java reserved keyword conflict.
